capabilities: Chat with the vault via an agent loop
Search and read notes, Bases and Canvas files
Write and edit notes through approval dialogs
Manage memory and skills as Markdown notes
Attach working context to each conversation
extras: Detailed tutorial, guides and troubleshooting live on an external documentation site. Local servers need CORS enabled or chat fails even though the connection test passes; models without native tool calling fall back to a less reliable text mode. README is provided in English and German.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in assistant that can search, read and edit notes while keeping writes under your control and your data on your own machine.
